results.description:
AnkiMobile is a mobile companion to Anki®, a powerful, intelligent flashcard program that is free, multi-platform, and open-source. Sales of this app support the development of both the computer and mobile version, which is why the app is priced as a computer application.

AnkiMobile was written by the lead developer of Anki and AnkiWeb, and it has been around since 2010. Beware other apps using "Anki" in their name that have sprung up recently - they are not compatible with the rest of the Anki ecosystem, and they offer far fewer features, despite charging expensive subscriptions.

Some of AnkiMobile's features include:

- A free cloud synchronization service that lets you keep your card content synchronized across multiple mobile and computer devices. This makes it easy to add content on a computer and then study it on your mobile, easily keep your study progress current between an iPhone and iPad, and so on.
- The same SM2 and FSRS scheduling algorithms that the computer version of Anki uses, which remind you of material as you're about to forget it.
- A flexible interface designed for smooth and efficient study. You can set up AnkiMobile to perform different actions when you tap or swipe on various parts of the screen, and control which actions appear on the tool buttons.
- Comprehensive graphs and statistics about your studies.
- Support for large card decks - even 100,000+ cards.
- If your cards use images or audio clips, the media is stored on your device, so you can study without an internet connection.
- A powerful search facility that allows you to find cards that match criteria such as 'tagged high priority, answered in the last ten days and not containing the following words', and automatically place them into a deck to study.
- Support for displaying mathematical equations with MathJax, and rendering LaTeX created with the computer version.
- Support for adding images drawn with the Apple Pencil to your cards.

Please note that AnkiMobile is currently intended as a companion to the computer version of Anki, rather than a complete replacement for it. While AnkiMobile is able to display and schedule your cards in the same way the computer version does, certain changes like modifying note types need to be done with the computer software. Add-ons are not supported, so while you can study image occlusion cards created with the computer version, they can not be created within AnkiMobile. For this reason, please start with the computer version of Anki before you think about buying this app.

The cloud synchronization service is optional, and data can also be imported/exported from the app via a USB cable or AirDrop.

Like all apps, AnkiMobile can be purchased once and then used on multiple devices in a household using the same Apple ID. Family sharing is also supported (apart from in India). For information on bulk discounts for educational institutions, please see Apple's Volume Purchase Program.

For more information on AnkiMobile, including a link to the online manual, please have a look at the support page: https://docs.ankimobile.net/support.html. If you have any questions or want to report an issue, please let us know on our support site and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

results.releaseNotes:
Browse, redesigned

 - Faster, more precise search. Type queries directly in syntax mode, or build them visually with filter chips. Saved and recent searches get you back to previous results in one tap.
 - Rebuilt card rows. Flags and marks are clearer at a glance, and rows support customizable swipe and tap actions. Tapping a card now opens Preview by default (you can change this).
 - Sort and view. Sort by any field, and switch between Card and Note view with one tap. A live result count updates as you search.
 - Bulk actions. Select multiple cards for Suspend, Bury, Flag, Tag, Move and Delete, with Select All. Any action can be undone from a quick Undo pill.
 - Updated Browse options and consistent icons throughout.

Deck list

 - See your workload at a glance. Each deck shows its New, Learning, Review and Total counts, as on desktop. Prefer a simpler view? Display options include a label-free Compact mode.
- Clearer sync status. The sync icon now shows when a sync is pending or needs attention.
 - Refreshed icons, spacing and typography across Decks, Stats and Study Options.

Also in this update

 - Notifications is now its own section in Preferences, with New, Learning and Review toggles for the app icon badge.
 - Fixed the editor toolbar clipping tools. It now scrolls, and long-pressing Cloze shows a labeled Next/Same menu.
 - Fixed Browse preview showing a blank screen after editing a card, and the flip control not returning to the question side.
 - Fixed several clipped labels and alerts.
 - The per-app language setting is now respected.
 - The sync conflict dialog matches desktop.
 - Improved VoiceOver support in Browse and on the Decks screen.
results.description:
Your decks, wherever you go! AnkiMobile is the official Anki app for iPhone and iPad, the flashcard app that more than 15 million learners worldwide have loved and trusted for over 20 years, made by the team behind Anki and AnkiWeb. Your purchase directly supports the open-source project that keeps Anki desktop free for everyone. Sync is included at no extra cost: no subscription, no sync fees. 

What you get:
 - Free sync with AnkiWeb. Keep your decks and study progress in sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, Linux, and the web. Add cards on your computer, study them on your phone.
 - The same SM-2 and FSRS scheduling as desktop Anki, so you review material right as you're about to forget it.
 - A flexible interface designed for smooth and efficient study.
 - Detailed graphs and statistics about your progress.
 - Support for large collections, including 100,000+ cards.
 - Offline study. Media (images and audio) is stored on your device.
 - Powerful search for building filtered decks, e.g. "tagged high priority, answered in the last ten days, and not containing these words".
 - MathJax equations and LaTeX rendering.
 - Apple Pencil support for adding hand-drawn images to cards.

Good to know: AnkiMobile works alongside the desktop version of Anki. Some tasks might require the desktop version, and add-ons are not supported on mobile yet.
Sync is optional. You can also import and export data over USB or AirDrop.

Buy once and use AnkiMobile on all your devices with the same Apple ID. Family Sharing is also supported. Educational institutions can find bulk discounts information through Apple's Volume Purchase Program.

Need help? The manual and support resources are at https://docs.ankiweb.net/ankimobile/support. If you have questions or want to report an issue, contact us through our support site.
